params.prompt: Educational animation reference diagram, loose graphite sketch style on white. Title at top: "The Acting Beat Pattern". A simple cartoon character drawn five times in a row, left to right, with a curved arrow running beneath the whole row. Each figure has ONE label, placed ABOVE it only, never repeated below: "Stage 1 — Thought (6-12fr)" standing still, eyes shifting; "Stage 2 — Anticipation (4-8fr)" coiling back away from the direction of travel; "Stage 3 — Action (fast)" lunging forward hard; "Stage 4 — Overshoot (3-5fr)" past the target and off balance; "Stage 5 — Settle (ease-out)" upright and still again. Labels appear once each, above the figures only. Footer: "Anticipation sells the action. Overshoot sells the weight.". No other text.
